examples: Open the app on your phone by scanning the link the menu bar hands you.
Hide the menu bar icon in settings, desktop app and keep working from the Dock alone; the Dock menu still lists what is waiting on you.
how_to: Carnivore lives in the Dock: closing the window leaves it running, and a Dock click brings the window back where you left it.
Settings, desktop app, show menu bar icon removes or restores the menu bar icon at once.

Cmd-Q quits the app and shows a one-time notice the first time; the engine keeps running with your agents, phone and web alerts, and the next launch picks it up again without a click. Quit and Stop Engine in the app menu and the menu bar also stops the engine.
If an engine from another version is still running when you open Carnivore, one dialog offers to restart it on this version (your agents keep running) or to quit and leave it.
Click the Carnivore icon: the header says whether the server is running, its version and whether a phone can reach it; Option-click adds a Debug submenu.
When a session is waiting on you, N Need You lists it; a click opens the approvals popup on that session, or the session itself at a startup prompt.
Open Sessions for the waiting and most recent sessions: Open in App, Watch in Terminal (read only), Type in Terminal, Copy Attach Command, or Restart... in the app.

Each session row wears a small status dot (green working, yellow waiting on you, light blue notice, gray idle as a disc and unknown as a ring, dark gray dead, red disconnected); one row per paired computer opens the Pack computers tab.

Phone Access copies the measured address or shows it as a QR, copies the sign-in code and shows the authenticator QR; Keep Mac Awake and Autonomy (Beast Mode, Swarm, Pause Scheduler, Stand Down) sit below it.

Click the Dock tile while the server is down: a small status window shows the same server-stopped facts and the Start Server, Terminal (Offline), Open Server Log in Console and Copy Diagnostics buttons; with the server up it raises or opens the app window.

While the server is down the header counts the agents still alive in tmux; Start Server, Terminal (Offline)..., Open Server Log in Console and Copy Diagnostics come first, and Server & Troubleshoot holds Start in Debug Mode, Kill Port Holder... and Reinstall Server Environment....

Set a feed with the CARNIVORE_UPDATE_FEED_URL environment variable or updates.feed_url in config.json; the menu then checks for updates at launch and a few times a day, downloads in the background and offers Restart to Update.
Server & Troubleshoot, Uninstall, Uninstall Carnivore... removes the app, its settings and its keychain items after you type UNINSTALL; your projects folder and Claude Code and Codex logins stay.
The Dock icon shows a red number when sessions are waiting on you, the same count as the menu bar icon's Need You row.
Right-click or hold the Dock icon for New Session, Recent Projects and the sessions waiting on you.
The Dock icon hops once when a new question arrives while Carnivore is behind other windows.
The menu bar at the top of the screen has Carnivore, File, Edit, View, Session, Window and Help; Help has the macOS search field, and Carnivore Help opens the help page in your browser.
File has New Session, New Window and Open Project; Session has Restart, Stop, Rename and Answer Waiting Question, which act on the session you are looking at.
Settings, desktop app, option key as meta makes Option-B, Option-F and Option-Backspace move and delete by word in every open terminal, with no reload.
Help, Export Diagnostics... (also in the menu bar icon menu) saves a redacted diagnostics zip wherever you choose; crash dumps and crash lines stay on your computer and nothing is sent.

Session menu, Open In Terminal App... (or the terminal widget menu, open in terminal app) opens the session in the terminal app you picked in settings, desktop app: Ghostty, iTerm2, Terminal, Kitty, WezTerm, or a custom command that Carnivore shows you in full and asks you to confirm the first time and whenever it changes.
Drag a folder from Finder onto the Carnivore icon in the Dock: it opens that project, or asks to add the folder as a project first.
Drag a file or folder from Finder onto a terminal: its quoted full path is typed at the prompt (not sent), so the agent can read it.

Session menu, Reveal in Finder and Open in Editor (and File menu, Reveal Project in Finder and Open Project in Editor) open the folder of the session in view or its project; the editor is the default editor set in Settings, General.

name: macOS menu bar app
summary: the Carnivore icon in the menu bar (a setting, on by default) next to the Dock app: it starts and stops the server and hands you the link and sign-in code for your phone.
where: The Carnivore icon in the macOS menu bar (settings, desktop app, show menu bar icon); Option-click it for the Debug submenu.
The Dock icon, which is always there while the app runs.
